# Verdictly

> Honest, community-powered reviews on everything — pets, movies, food, cars, sports, and more.

Verdictly is a review aggregator and community platform where real users share genuine experiences. Every review includes a star rating, personal narrative, and community discussion thread. Content spans thousands of subjects across multiple categories.

## Browse by Category
{% for cat in categories %}
- [{{ cat.name }}]({{ base_url }}/{{ cat.slug }}/): {{ cat.description or 'Browse reviews for ' + cat.name }}
{% endfor %}

## What You'll Find

- **Animal reviews**: Detailed experiences from pet owners covering temperament, care needs, costs, health, and suitability for families — covering dogs, cats, rabbits, parrots, reptiles, and more.
- **Movie reviews**: Audience opinions on Marvel, DC, animated films, anime series, TV shows, and classic cinema.
- **Food reviews**: Real opinions on world cuisines — Italian, Japanese, Mexican, Ukrainian, and 60+ more.
- **Car reviews**: Owner experiences by make, model, and year.
- **Sports reviews**: Fan takes on teams, athletes, and events.

## Data

- Reviews are written by real users or aggregated from public review platforms.
- Each subject shows an aggregate star rating (1–5) and total review count.
- Users can submit new reviews directly on any subject page.
